scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street with tall buildings lining both sides, featuring a mix of old and new architecture, including a prominent tree in the middle of the sidewalk, with a bus driving down the street and two cyclists riding past, set against a cloudy sky with a few cars parked along the curb.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings have a mix of old and new styles, with some featuring ornate facades and others having more modern designs, while the tree stands out as a focal point in the center of the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.materials: The buildings' exterior walls are primarily made of stone, with some sections featuring large windows and balconies, while others have a more uniform texture and color scheme.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans placed along the sidewalk, providing a place for pedestrians to rest and dispose of waste.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The tree in the center of the sidewalk adds a touch of greenery to the otherwise urban landscape, its branches stretching up towards the sky.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted along the street, including directional signs and advertisements for local businesses.
